more: Whose license it is comes from the owner's own words: the business's, the owner's, or a license holder's.
A license holder gives their own number after their invite, by text or on the secure page. Rosie does not check it.
Where the rules ask for insurance or a bond, the owner may add it here too, as its own word.
Licenses: S13-43. A license claim shows as the owner's word, not as checked.
Never: let a license stand for control (S1-75), or say a license is checked.
Safe default: the owner's word is kept, and that work is booked only as the owner says it is licensed.

say.text: The state may license the business itself, and each person. What's the license number? You can skip it if your work doesn't need one.
say.plainText: The state may license the business itself, and each person. What's the license number? You can skip it if your work doesn't need one.

say.text: Thanks. I've kept it as your own word. Rosie doesn't look it up. Let's keep going.
say.plainText: Thanks. I've kept it as your own word. Rosie doesn't look it up. Let's keep going.

ops.does: The plug-in names no license to check here. Rosie asks only for the business registration, where one is required, and keeps it as the owner's word.
more: Insured or bonded shows only once the owner says so.
The registration's name and number must match the listing. Stripe's name check reads it (S1-27).
Customers see no license claim. Each person is asked for nothing either, unless the plug-in names something.
A price-list service that is a licensed kind of work still takes its license step (S1-12). Registration never covers it.

say.text: Send the business registration number, if it has one. I'll keep it as your own word.

say.text: Thanks. It's kept as your word, and nothing is looked up. Customers see no license claim.

ops.does: Nothing shows to AI assistants until the ID and the control of the business are confirmed. Licenses are the owner's word and are not looked up.
more: Means 'Confirmed in minutes': the ID and the control of the business check out.
The ID is the owner's upload, accepted as given, so it never fails to match.
Control still with Rosie's team (S1-75): that company stays offline, setup saved, while the rest goes on.
